tests.title: parses all seven IRCAM magics with their field endianness and both tag tables
rounds the float rate with lrintf semantics and refuses platform-dependent rates
refuses IRCAM headers with native exit statuses in native order
probes native IRCAM heads, confirms the second form with bounded reads and never detects by extension
ports av_q2intfloat for IRCAM output rates and writes the 1024-byte little-endian header
aborts IRCAM output exactly once and honors cancellation
registers the IRCAM descriptor with native names, extensions, codecs and packet span
matches native IRCAM mux bytes for 8 codecs x 3 layouts x 5 rates x 4 lengths and decodes them back
matches native IRCAM demux for all seven magics and both tag tables through copy framecrc, WAV decode and raw output
matches native IRCAM packet timing through copy and filtered framecrc with seeks, durations and frame limits
matches the native lrintf IRCAM float sample rate on ties and fractions
refuses IRCAM inputs and outputs with the native exit status before any output exists
matches the FATE lavf-ircam reference exactly

details: 480 whole-file mux byte comparisons (8 codecs x 3 channel counts x 5 rates x 4 lengths)
96 raw copy comparisons of native-written files
504 demux comparisons: 7 magics x 8 tags x 3 channel counts x (copy framecrc, WAV decode, raw copy)
14 detection/-f ircam framecrc and exit-status comparisons
42 float-rate framecrc comparisons (21 rates x LE/BE)
4 FATE lavf-ircam checks: md5, size, decode CRC against tests/ref/lavf/ircam, plus native md5 with the original options

unsupported: Extension-score detection of unprobed heads (0x64A30400) without -f ircam: native's score-1 extension match is payload dependent
Non-finite, >=2^31, < -2^31 or negative float rates (exit 1 refusal)
Input seek at or beyond EOF
BE, unsigned and other non-LE-table output codecs (refused with 234 like native, but native leaves an empty file)
FLAC input to the ircam muxer

proposedContracts.name: matches native IRCAM mux bytes for 8 codecs x 3 layouts x 5 rates x 4 lengths and decodes them back
proposedContracts.scope: 480 whole-file native -bitexact -f ircam comparisons: 8 LE codecs x 1/2/5 channels x 8000/22050/44100/96000/16777217 Hz x 0/1/67/4097 samples (av_q2intfloat rate word), plus 96 raw copy demux comparisons of native files.

proposedContracts.name: matches native IRCAM demux for all seven magics and both tag tables through copy framecrc, WAV decode and raw output
proposedContracts.scope: All 7 native magics x 8 tags (LE and BE variants) x 1/2/5 channels through copy framecrc, -cpuflags 0 WAV decode and raw copy; undeclared detection and -f ircam for each magic.

proposedContracts.name: matches native IRCAM packet timing through copy and filtered framecrc with seeks, durations and frame limits
proposedContracts.scope: 32 framecrc cases: 4 codecs x 4 seek/duration/frame-limit profiles x copy or a fixed volume/asetnsamples/asetrate chain at 8000 Hz stereo.

proposedContracts.name: matches the native lrintf IRCAM float sample rate on ties and fractions
proposedContracts.scope: 21 finite in-range float32 rates (ties, fractions, large powers of two) in LE and BE headers; whole copy framecrc including #sample_rate. Non-finite and >=2^31 rates are refused, not compared.

proposedContracts.name: refuses IRCAM inputs and outputs with the native exit status before any output exists
proposedContracts.scope: Native exit statuses for unknown tags, 0/513 channels, zero rates, unknown magic, truncated header (183/218) and 7 unsupported mux codecs (234), with no Edge output created.

proposedContracts.name: matches the FATE lavf-ircam reference exactly
proposedContracts.scope: FATE lavf-ircam: audiogen asynth1.sw compiled at test time; Edge output md5/size equal tests/ref/lavf/ircam and the Adler-32 of its decode equals the reference CRC. -metadata/-qscale dropped (no effect on native md5, checked).

notes: No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed; packages/containers/src/index.ts is unchanged (tests import the module by path).
The ircam descriptor overrides packetSpan with ff_pcm_default_packet_size (including the INT_MAX/block_align clip); it equals pcmPacketSpan for every non-clipped case.
Input header bytes past EOF read as zero (avio_rl32 semantics), so truncated headers reach native's own refusals.
Setup durations: submodule init 48s, npm ci 8s, reference:build 197s, baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 65s, baseline unit suite 87s; own differential file ~14s.
Baseline failures are the expected FLAC artifact (downloads.xiph.org blocked) and resample-checkpoint macOS-digest failures.
